componentSpecs.name: LeavePolicy (model)
componentSpecs.description: TypeScript interface at src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts. Defines 11 attributes: id (string), policyName (string), leaveType (LeaveType enum from src/shared/types/leave.types.ts), entitlementDays (number), accrualRate (number | null), maxAccumulation (number | null), minimumNoticeDays (number | null), requiresManagerApproval (boolean), isActive (boolean), createdAt (Date), updatedAt (Date). Also exports LeavePolicyQueryParams = Partial<Pick<LeavePolicy, 'leaveType' | 'isActive'>>. Leaf module — no internal dependencies beyond shared types.

Declares 6 methods: findByLeaveType(leaveType: LeaveType): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>, findById(id: string): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>, findAll(params?: LeavePolicyQueryParams): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>, create(policy: Omit<LeavePolicy, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): Promise<LeavePolicy>, update(id: string, policy: Partial<Omit<LeavePolicy, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>>): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>, softDelete(id: string): Promise<boolean>. Concrete PgLeavePolicyRepository implementation deferred to later phase. Unit tests at tests/unit/modules/policy/policy.repository.test.ts use a MockLeavePolicyRepository to verify all 6 method contracts.
